title: Joint Distributional Copula Regression for Insurance Claim Frequency and Severity via Boosting
abstract: arXiv:2610.36835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a model-based boosting approach for fitting structured additive distributional copula regression models with bivariate responses, focusing particularly on the joint modeling of claim frequency and claim severity. The proposed approach is based on generalized additive models for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS), which extend the general idea of GAMs by allowing multiple parameters of a response distribution, rather than only its conditional mean, to depend on covariates. The model is therefore intrinsically interpretable at the level of its additive predictors, providing greater transparency and auditability than black-box alternatives. We evaluate the proposed framework using synthetic and real-world data. We demonstrate its ability to recover the underlying covariate effects and dependence structure, identify informative variables, and achieve competitive predictive performance relative to benchmark models.

translated_title: 基于Boosting的保险理赔频率与严重度联合分布Copula回归
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于模型的boosting方法，用于拟合具有二元响应的结构化加性分布copula回归模型，特别聚焦于理赔频率与理赔严重度的联合建模。该方法基于位置、尺度和形状广义可加模型（GAMLSS），它扩展了GAM的一般思想，允许响应分布的多个参数（而不仅仅是条件均值）依赖于协变量。因此，该模型在加性预测器的层面上具有内在的可解释性，相比黑盒替代方案提供了更高的透明度和可审计性。我们使用合成数据和真实数据对所提出的框架进行了评估，展示了其恢复潜在协变量效应和依赖结构、识别信息性变量，以及相对于基准模型取得有竞争力预测性能的能力。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于GAMLSS的模型化boosting方法来拟合结构化加性分布copula回归模型，实现保险理赔频率与严重度的联合建模，兼具加性预测器层面的可解释性、变量筛选能力与有竞争力的预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-based boosting approach for structured additive distributional copula regression under the GAMLSS framework, enabling joint modeling of insurance claim frequency and severity with interpretable additive predictors, effective variable selection, and competitive predictive performance.
